# sink_green_soap_bottle — articulation audit and repair

Status: **FAIL / incomplete physical certification**. The repaired rig passes synthetic collision checks; the supplied video does not show actuation for this asset. No ARTCHECK_DONE marker is warranted.

- Changed the already-open zero mesh to a closed cap with a real back-edge pivot.
- Stored the persistent source opening as an explicit observed q; fitted hinge azimuth from static views.
- Added neck contact sectors and MJCF/URDF exports; dry friction is an unmeasured holding prior.

The ten-position sweeps include every original joint with explicit inter-body contacts, including parent/child pairs. Maximum baseline penetration: 0.0000 mm; repaired penetration: 0.0000 mm. The exported visual triangles were also swept at ten positions per joint; see the report for their separate results. Coupled endpoint states: 2. GLB/OBJ maximum vertex discrepancy: 0.00000104 mm.

Calibrated source frames: f0008, f0168, f3684. Strict maximum assembly edge error across these views: 46.53 px; worst frame p95: 24.21 px. These exceed the requested 10 px maximum. All measurements are at 1280 x 1707 before review resizing. Source masks, per-part traced edges, geometry projections and actual CPU Cycles renders are retained. Silhouette fitting, material/specular boundaries, glass, occlusion and calibration/scale uncertainty remain limitations; this is not a 1 cm metric certification.

No maximum actuation or physical stop can be recovered from these unactuated frames. The open cap is a static state, not an observed motion sequence.
